market_definition: The rubber-based pressure-sensitive adhesives market comprises permanently tacky adhesives built on natural or synthetic rubber elastomers combined with tackifiers. It measures sales of formulated adhesives in solvent, water and hot-melt form. BY ELASTOMER BASE: Natural Rubber, SBC (SIS / SBS), Butyl / Polyisobutylene, Other Synthetic Rubbers. BY TECHNOLOGY: Solvent-Borne, Water-Borne, Hot Melt. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Packaging Tapes, Masking & Paint Tapes, Labels, Medical & Hygiene, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Acrylic and silicone PSAs; styrenic block copolymer hot melts sold for non-PSA use; finished tapes. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies.
